tweets.text: This past weekend, border wall panel installation began in Nogales, Arizona. This project will close an approximately 0.2-mile opening in the border wall, that was planned for completion during the first Trump administration but was subsequently cancelled by the Biden Administration.  Once completed, this will result in an approximately 9-mile contiguous stretch of border wall securing the border in this area.
